card.name: Final piece of delavirdine and rare names
card.fires_on: The closing piece of the drug name delavirdine ("ine" after Delavird), in HIV drug-interaction lists. It also fires on the last piece of a few rare proper names such as Grumeti, NutriBase and Glaxo Wellcome.
